authorizedFollowup.productionChanges: Only the new space engine: finite long-session saves, genuine30/14 boost, fixed completedAt, ledger-accounted six-second requested rescue.
authorizedFollowup.findingsStatus: All three findings below describe the original audit probes and have now been resolved by authorized followup changes.

audit.scope: Read-only engine/controller review and ordinary runtime probes. The 3D scene is planar XZ flight; decorative asteroids are not colliders and no collision-physics claim is made.
confirmedWorking: Controller manualMode sets demoAuto false before held flight input is processed; the next nonzero physics step cancels autopilot. The scripted demo cannot reclaim control after a takeover.
Explicit takeover also stops navigation and preserves the same model, velocity, cargo and cash.
Restore always pauses and reconstructs financial transactions, FIFO purchase basis, courier reservations/rewards, survey reward, cash, profit, fuel purchases/burn, and cargo counts.
Completed achievement stays recorded even after later losing trades; this is legal continued play rather than an account mismatch.

findings.topic: Fuel exhaustion far from a port can strand manual play
findings.reproduction: Create a manual world, undock, hold boost for180 seconds, then brake for2 seconds. No model editing or rewarded phase shortcuts.
findings.suggestion: Optional small recovery action or an explicit stranded-state message explaining the available reset. The ordinary demonstration consumes only about2.13 fuel, so its goal is unaffected.

findings.topic: Runtime can produce a legal save that its arbitrary7200-second restore cap rejects
findings.reproduction: Stay docked at dawn and call stepWorld(world,5)1441 times; the engine continues normally.
findings.suggestion: Remove the arbitrary runtime-duration cap while retaining finite numeric and conservation checks, or enforce and communicate the same session limit in runtime.

findings.topic: Boost at already-full throttle has identical motion but higher fuel burn
findings.reproduction: Undock two fresh worlds and fly for2 seconds with thrust1, enabling boost only for the second.
findings.suggestion: Describe Shift as full-throttle engagement and its higher fuel cost, or give boost a genuine benefit within the maximum-speed/acceleration contract.

audit.limitations: Save validation checks arithmetic and state consistency, not cryptographic authenticity of user-edited localStorage.
